source.stem: Decide whether the following statements are correct. Mark “√” for correct answers and “×” for wrong answers. (1) Objects that can move must be living things.

hinge.title: Explain neutralisation as sufficient mixing of an acid and a base to form a solution that is neither acidic nor basic.

spec.instruction: Write one new grades 7 Science question. Chapter: Acids, bases and salts. The student must decide: Explain neutralisation as sufficient mixing of an acid and a base to form a solution that is neither acidic nor basic. Use an Indian school or home setting and Indian names. Keep the source language register. Change the numbers, materials, or everyday situation. Do not copy the source stem. Recalculate the key. Do not print mix-up labels, hinge codes, node codes, or the word CANDIDATE. If the stem numbers activities 1..n, every number must appear in an option (or in a structured part's first-class options). Two-tier (choose, then reason) is welcome: put A/B/C on part.options, not typed into part text.
